name: Route Typeform Feedback to Airtable and Trello

parameters.jsCode:
function feedback({response}){if(!Array.isArray(response?.definition?.fields)||!Array.isArray(response?.answers))throw Error('Expected the complete Typeform response');const read=(title,type,required)=>{const matches=response.definition.fields.filter(x=>x?.title===title);if(matches.length!==1||!matches[0].id||response.definition.fields.filter(x=>x.id===matches[0].id).length!==1)throw Error('Expected one question titled '+title);const answers=response.answers.filter(x=>x?.field?.id===matches[0].id);if(!answers.length&&!required)return '';if(answers.length!==1||answers[0].type!==type)throw Error('Invalid answer for '+title);const v=answers[0][type];if(type==='number'?(typeof v!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(v)):(typeof v!=='string'||(required&&!v.trim())))throw Error('Invalid answer for '+title);return v};const fields={Name:read('What is your name?','text',true),Email:read('What is your email address?','email',false),Score:read('What score would you like to give?','number',true),Description:read('Anything else you want to share?','text',false)};return {fields,records:[{fields}]}}

if($json.event_type!=="form_response")throw Error("Expected a completed Typeform response");return {json:feedback({response:$json.form_response}).fields};
